note: Every day’s key verse (blockquote) and every quoted fragment is the Bíblia Livre para o Mundo (porbrbsl, the ebible mirror’s por_bpm USFM) copied by script; the citation drops (BSB). Where the Bíblia Livre nests its own “ ” inside the outer quotation they are set as ‘ ’, as in Book 1. Rows are measured: mined only where a Bíblia Livre span of the cited verse appears in that block.

Where the Bíblia Livre differs from the BSB the English teaches from, the verse is kept and the explanation follows it: John 1:1 «o Verbo» (glossed as ‘palavra’); Mark 1:17 «Vinde após mim» is three words, not two; John 2:11 «princípio de seus sinais»; Luke 2:52 «graça diante de Deus e dos homens» (glossed); Matthew 5:3–9 «bem-aventurados», «mansos»; Matthew 5:15 «candeia» (glossed); John 19:30 «Está consumado» is two words, not three; Matthew 28:20’s closing «Amém» is left out of the blockquote. The introduction’s parents’ note names the Bíblia Livre instead of the BSB.
